# Third-party browser libraries

- `markdown-it-15.0.3.min.js`: markdown-it 15.0.3, MIT license. Source: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it, distributed at https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/markdown-it@15.0.3/dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js. License in `markdown-it-LICENSE.txt`.

This pinned library is served locally. There are no runtime CDN requests. Markdown rendering disables raw HTML and replaces images with text, avoiding hidden network requests from document previews.
